baseline.summary: Initial mathematical baseline: the canonical square-wheel nonzero response is identified exactly with the centered PNT-corrected comb minus twice the centered Mertens-weighted reciprocal-interval prime-count discrepancy.

last_witness.summary: Closes the square-run track and the prime-wheel track onto one seam. Admitting a fresh Euler prime to a finite old universe acts on a signed window by W_{S+p}(A,B) = W_S(A,B) - W_S(A/p,B/p), so a new prime contributes one compressed predecessor-cube window rather than an independent copy of a parent. Combining that with the frozen square-run kernel K(a,b) = M(a^2-1) - M((b+1)^2-1) and the canonical low-wheel endpoint involution M(R^2-1) = M(R) - D_R gives K(a,b) = (M(a)-M(b+1)) + (D_{b+1}-D_a), whose Mertens gap costs at most the root interval length. The energy of the change in the canonical downcross frontier is therefore equivalent, with no loss, to the frozen square-run criterion, the global Mertens-energy criterion, the maximal signed square-run criterion, and the synchronized primorial-wheel residual criterion. Exact late-parent cancellation at both endpoints makes D_{b+1}-D_a literally the difference of canonically oriented Euler first-crossing ledgers. No pointwise bound on D_R, prime-gap estimate, PNT input, or asymptotic estimate is used.

description: Monotone ledger for cross-track synthesis theorems. Revision 0 is the publication baseline; each accepted synthesis pull request increments revision exactly once, and its last_witness must directly invoke pre-existing anchors from both source tracks. A republication carrying many upstream advances forward does not manufacture a revision for them: results decisive within one track are recorded under companion_witnesses instead, and revision moves only when a witness meets the two-anchor coupling requirement of the gate.

companion_witnesses.summary: Closes the post-root loop in one inequality. Both terms subtracted in the Bessel identity 2E(W) = M(W)^2 - complementDiagonalResidual(W) - familyMertensSquareEnergy(W) are nonnegative, so E(W) <= M(W)^2/2 holds unconditionally, with no cancellation, record hypothesis or sieve. That makes the remainder, envelope, record-excess, falling finite-difference, Mertens square envelope and Mertens energy statements one equivalence class. Read quantitatively it is an exchange rate with exponent factor two, and therefore also a no-go: nothing in the post-root or record machinery can move the remainder exponent without first moving the Mertens exponent.

Makes the record step itself the carrier of the remaining problem. The one-step innovation budget splits without any triangle inequality, because the physical row and the square-wall departure have disjoint support; a positive record forces envelope(N) * N^eps < innovation(N), a full endpoint power stronger than naive localization; and the departure is supported exactly on prime squares, so its normalized sum is bounded unconditionally by p^2 sparsity alone. What stays unbounded is the record-conditioned outer row, and the record indicator in the majorant is load-bearing.

Moves the surviving outer row down to the individual Moebius square-energy increment. Fresh-prime transport cancels the diagonal squares exactly, so twice the outer row is the difference of two discrete Mertens-square increments; at a positive record integrality forces a gap of at least one, converting the identity into a one-sided charge against the cumulative square gap.

Performs the global subtraction the pointwise top/bottom toggle never took. The move is injective with an explicit inverse, so the frozen nontrivial-cofactor ledger is exactly minus the signed mass of its image, and that image is disjoint from the whole downcross carrier: a genuine relocation onto the post-root side rather than an internal reshuffle. With the already-proved movable cancellation this sharpens the endpoint identity to D_R = U_R + F_R^(c=1) - T_R, which still implies the Riemann hypothesis through the square-prefix energy bridge.

Closes the obvious next move. Every high-prime population is indexed by a prime above the root while every image state is rough-free below it, so the two are complementary rather than nested and the proposed containment holds only vacuously. Independently the relocation is norm preserving, so bounding the relocated ledger is bounding the frozen sector itself.

Records that the largest-prime stable defect is the terminal seam rather than a reduction of it: the coordinate synthesis is an identity of the same signed object, so the two linear bounds are equivalent in both directions and either proves the strong Mertens bound. The RH-scale target is the epsilon-loss bound, and the cardinality route is separately dead by a full power of R.

Turns the last piece of stable-wall multiplicity into a classical object. At a fixed far prime with A = floor(X_R/p), the unit-terminal condition q*p <= X_R < q^2*p is exactly sqrt(A) < q <= A, so the incoming renewal count is the number of primes in a reciprocal interval rather than an opaque weight.

Removes the selected-prime contraction from the terminal induction. With the sharp odd-owner budget sum_(q odd) 1/q^2 <= 17/72 and the 36/35 Young split for the endpoint transfer, a factor-four recurrence on the fully signed, fully reassembled physical daughters has effective coefficient 4*(36/35)*(17/72) = 34/35 < 1, which alone gives linear Mertens energy and the Riemann hypothesis.

Refutes the six-contact frame route by fibre counting rather than by a constant. The frame constant is two for an arbitrary field, since q odd splits the six offsets into three mod-four pairs, and the assembled coefficient norm the estimate bounds is a different object from the recursive Mertens energy the induction consumes, separated by an exact finite witness. The operative consequence is that q^2 children must be reassembled with their signs before any norm.

Promotes a coordinate bridge into the proof graph: the signed truncated prime-wheel kernel exposed by the rough-seat Fubini collapse is exactly the chronological frozen prime cube already used by the first-owner and Go machinery. No norm, estimate or change of carrier is used.

Pushes the complete post-crossing renewal row back from reciprocal depth onto the cofactor coordinate. The coupled tail after a shallow reciprocal-packet crossing equals an explicit packet baseline minus the signed Moebius pairing with one intact rough-prime cofactor response, and the same object is re-expressed through its centered mean and covariance. The remaining nonlocal cancellation is therefore a literal finite correlation between the Moebius parity field and one rough-prime response field. This is an exact coordinate identity: no mean-zero assertion, norm split, independence hypothesis, or estimate is used.

Reindexes the signed mass of the squared vertical factor strip onto the ordered Euler cut atoms and proves it exactly equal to the canonical oriented Euler run ledger, before any norm. The companion identities send the same run to the canonical defect ledger and to the signed prefix lifetime residual, so the complex/Fermat, ordered Euler, oriented downcross, lifetime and canonical defect coordinates are one analytic problem, not five. The energy proposition stated there is proved equal to the pre-existing oriented-run seam, so the coordinate change hides no estimate.

Squares the whole signed birth/death population on physical squared-Fermat child lines before any absolute value, giving the finite Green--Kubo identity ||V||^2 = D_line + 2 C_line with event(n) = mu(n) * chi(n). The diagonal is already at root-square scale, so the only quantity able to produce supercritical growth is the positive aggregate covariance among distinct physical birth/death lines.

Sharpens the line-event diagonal from the pointwise envelope 1 to the exact squarefree diagonal mu(n)^2, so the limiting 40/30/30 law is used only in the safe direction: the zero population sharpens the diagonal, and no sign balance is asserted on the arithmetically selected birth/death set.

Transports the native square-prefix PNT mechanism onto the RH-critical canonical rough covariance carrier: a fresh-prime parent/child pair is compressed back onto the parent with the exact Euler factor 1 - 1/p, and every failure of exact contraction is confined to the threshold-loss, top-escape and lower-root birth channels, suppressed by the reciprocal child cofactor. The two-prime Boolean square accumulates the factors exactly.

On a complete sub-root Euler cube the threshold-loss channel is literally empty, top escapes are forced strictly beyond the root and births stay strictly below it. The critical signed boundary is exactly post-root top escape minus lower-root birth, with one whole defect channel removed before any norm is taken.

Identifies each physical defect shell, with its native 1/p restored, as the discrepancy between the true next truncated Euler cube and the uniform Euler contraction, and telescopes those discrepancies over an arbitrary duplicate-free descending prime list to the single final truncated-wheel boundary T_L(N) - EulerProduct(L). This replaces the (1-P)*Delta majorant by a structural identity taken before absolute values.

Closes the prime-weighted discrete boundary variation left by the unweighted physical columns. Because the boundary profile is stationary off the primes, finite summation by parts returns the Abel primitive sum_{n<K} B_n(X) - K * B_K(X). The RH-critical object attached to the physical columns is therefore that combination, not the endpoint boundary alone.

A post-root prime family is an isometric copy of a lower-scale prefix for pair covariance: mu(pc)mu(pd) = mu(c)mu(d) reverses family mass but preserves family covariance, so the covariance strictly inside the p-family is the global Moebius covariance at the reduced scale. The companion refinement identity moves square-block energy into children plus an explicit signed cross term, with the leaf energy exactly the linear squarefree diagonal.

States the one-sided positive-lag frontier as a descent on the signed aggregate covariance itself: every supercritical normalized excursion is forced by a strictly smaller supercritical scale, which on the naturals forbids a minimal one and hence any. The same module records, with a measurement, that support-only frontier capacity cannot close the argument, because the minimising pivot has linear frontier and the F^2 term stays a full power above target.

Plays the two sitewise Othello laws on a whole cumulative region at once. The carrier toggle is an involution whose moving states carry reversed Moebius sign and whose frozen states carry none, so the signed mass of any finite region is exactly the signed mass of its escape part, and peeling a list of distinguished primes preserves that equality on the iterated boundary.

The genuinely trajectory-based cancellation: an atom born after a run starts and captured before it ends costs the run exactly nothing, whatever its lifetime. Death is proved permanent on the actual active predicate, so the half-open interval model is faithful, and the aggregate run identity holds in the existing Active = Birth - Death endpoint coordinates.

Constructs internally the one direction of the classical Mertens criterion the terminal route consumes, from the Dirichlet series for 1/zeta, partial summation, the identity theorem and the completed-zeta reflection. The resulting implication from the square-prefix energy estimate to Mathlib's Riemann hypothesis carries no criterion hypothesis at all, so the reduction is unconditional down to the arithmetic estimate itself.

Unconditional endpoint-form crossing theorem: for every positive logarithmic constant, the intact upper-middle reciprocal packet eventually crosses at a depth below that multiple of the log endpoint. The mechanism is endpoint-parametric; the exact rational witness at depth 18800 is used only internally and is checked by native_decide.

Separates the raw transport tail from the coupled tail, which adds the complete square-root-smooth population, and proves a critical root-scale coupled-tail bound equivalent to the square-prefix Mertens energy criterion.

Cancels every interior transport state by the canonical least-prime cofactor/quotient involution and leaves the endpoint identity M(R^2-1) = M(R) - canonicalDowncross, with every defect term on one adjacent multiplicative shell frontier and no prime-counting coefficient anywhere.
Shows an arbitrary fixed absolute amplification constant in the square-root endpoint statement already closes the standard Mertens energy criterion; no subunit contraction is required.

First uniform quantitative bound on a corrected-conductor packet, 6*q^3, from one incomplete conductor period. The companion sector theorem in the same module sums it to O(R^4) over all nontrivial conductors up to R, uniformly in the prefix length.

Forms the combined signed residual channel by channel, before the cofactor sum, so the reciprocal-cutoff floor rounding and the prime-counting discrepancy are never separable, and proves the resulting Gram identity and criterion equivalence.
Makes the residual gap explicit: the matched criterion alone does not bound the square-prefix Mertens value, and together with the positive-orientation statement it does.
Proves the top block of the transport transform equals its own cardinality, so it admits no internal cancellation and no bounded-boundary decomposition can absorb it.

Identifies the middle-minus-top fibre population difference with the exact PNT coordinate 2*pi(X/2) - pi(X) - pi(R). The identity is unconditional and its sign is not decided by first-order PNT, because the leading X/log X terms cancel.
Proves the complete-period CRT core empty whenever the selected prime-square product exceeds the square-block window width, so the interior mass vanishes and the whole physical mass is boundary.

Refutes the literal same-site bounded collision-defect quotient: every corrected weight vanishes at the square hit, so every bounded chain mass is zero, contradicting the first nontrivial square prefix.
